correctness.rationale: Pass applies to the replacement RESULT.md, not an unqualified translation invariance of extremizing directions in the frozen Finding. In the stated ordinary norm, for an extremizing sign vector ε with both signs, J(ε+c1)=Jε but ||ε+c1||∞=1+|c|, so c≠0 strictly lowers the ratio. The repair specifies actual centered direction vectors and separately explains the quotient interpretation and the translation invariance of the base scores. For a maximizing interior Jacobian, cube duality and PSD Cauchy–Schwarz force any normalized maximizing direction to maximize its quadratic form on the cube; J_ii>0 makes every nonvertex direction strictly improvable in some coordinate. The repaired proof derives the threshold derivative at α<2 even across support boundaries, since the positive-part power is C¹ and the derivative of total mass in the threshold is negative. At α=2 the piecewise-affine restriction to an arbitrary segment handles boundaries without passing to a discontinuous full-support Jacobian. The exact sign-cut norm is 4AB/(A+B). Jensen is strict within each nonconstant positive-mass block for α<2, and the unique optimal mass ratio is (h/k)^γ. The positive derivative of log F on 0<k/h<1 gives unique balanced sizes (up to complement), the strict odd deficit and the asserted pattern. Sharpness comes from differentiating at an interior witness; the constant map for n=1, full-support sparsemax and the limiting softmax statement also check. No uploaded code was executed.
residual_risks: The direction classification concerns interior differential maximizers, not arbitrary support degeneracies or equality between distinct finite scores. The author's recorded finite checks do not certify the equality classification.
